measure.bodyEdges: 3D distance to target.ApproachPoint minus own and target body radius (soldiers only)
measure.toHull: XZ distance from pivot to target.ApproachPoint (a ship's oriented hull)

queue.appendable: Move, AttackMove, Patrol; only when the unit is not Idle/Hold
queue.clearing: Attack, Follow, Stop, Hold clear the queue
queue.patrol: completing a patrol swaps its ends and never drains the queue
queue.shipAttackMove: a ship attack-move resumes its destination when its target dies
queue.soldierAttackMove: a soldier attack-move resumes its path when its target dies
queue.ships: ships receive direct orders, no queue

click: enemy ship with an attack-capable fleet beats the harbor
town with a port and a fleet: dock at its port
enemy target: soldiers Attack via inbox, attack ships Attack directly
own transport with a selection: embark
enemy tower: attack-move to its claim point / landing
ground: move (attack-move to a hostile town/harbor point)
